item.title: Project Hail Mary Box Office Shatters Expectations With Massive $140.9 Million Global Debut
item.description: The Project Hail Mary box office exploded with a $140.9 million global debut, giving Amazon MGM its biggest theatrical win and the top opening of 2026.

item.title: More Ubisoft Layoffs Hit as Development Ends at Red Storm Entertainment
item.description: Troubled video game studio Ubisoft announced another round of layoffs as it ends development at Red Storm Entertainment.

item.title: Yellowstone Spinoff ‘Dutton Ranch’ Sets Premiere Date, Expands Taylor Sheridan Universe Yet Again
item.description: Yellowstone spinoff Dutton Ranch sets a May 15, 2026 premiere date on Paramount+, bringing Beth and Rip back for another violent ranch war in Texas.

item.title: Crunchyroll Security Breach: 100GB of User Data Potentially Compromised
item.description: A Crunchyroll security breach may have exposed the personal data of thousands of subscribers to the anime streaming service.

item.title: Starfleet Academy Canceled: Paramount Pulls Plug After Ratings Collapse
item.description: Starfleet Academy canceled by Paramount as the Star Trek series struggles with viewership and fails to appear on Nielsen streaming charts.

item.title: John Boyega Confirms He's Spoken to Dave Filoni About a Return to 'Star Wars'
item.description: John Boyega confirmed at MEGACON that he has spoken with Dave Filoni about bring his character Finn back to Star Wars.

item.title: Live Action Moana Trailer Destroyed by Fans With Mass Dislike Ratio
item.description: The trailer for the live-action Moana reboot received immediate online backlash and a shocking ratio on YouTube.

item.title: Children's YouTuber Ms. Rachel Admits "I Am Political" as She Opposes ICE
item.description: Ms. Rachel says she is political, as the prominent children's YouTuber takes an active role against a government detention center.

item.title: Politicians Suddenly Vanish From The View as FCC Scrutiny Intensifies
item.description: The View politicians disappear from the show after an FCC investigation, raising new questions about guest bias and equal time rules.

item.title: Marvel Greenlights Wonder Man Season 2 Despite Weak Viewership and Early Drop-Off
item.description: Marvel renewed Wonder Man for Season 2 despite weak viewership, early Top 10 drop-off, and disappointing engagement compared to other MCU Disney+ series.
